proposition: Melvin-Koushki holds that the Mafahis is the centrepiece of Ibn Turka's oeuvre and the basis of his fame in the Timurid and Safavid periods; the evidence he adduces on the page is the Afandi and Khwandamir notices and the early copy.

mediation.note: MK's own interpretation, offered in support of his thesis that Ibn Turka was an occult philosopher.
